summary: Regression-tested backend APIs and end-to-end ASTRO LIVE flows. Sessions, astrologers, saved-reading persistence, horoscope save, consultation save, share interaction, live-room state transitions, and mobile overflow checks passed.
critical_code_review_comments: No 5xx responses observed and no application console errors were reported during the exercised flows.
The browser run reported a test-script-only SyntaxError in its final error-selector evaluate expression; app flow assertions had already passed.
Fallback session and astrologer constants remain in frontend code, but backend data successfully replaced them during normal API operation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of application assertions (final test diagnostic had a selector quoting error)

seed_data_creation: Created one TEST regression saved reading through POST for persistence verification; it remains in the backend collection because no delete endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL tested. GET /api/sessions and /api/astrologers returned 200; POST then GET /api/saved-readings verified persistence. Desktop browser verified save, Saved navigation, consultation save, live room waiting/active/ended, and share interaction. Mobile 390x844 had no horizontal overflow.
rca of the issue: No product issue reproduced. The only failure was in the test harness: the JavaScript selector string used single quotes both for the outer Python string and an inner CSS attribute selector, producing a Page.evaluate SyntaxError after all product assertions completed.
